name: Armenia

flag.description: Three equal horizontal stripes of red, blue and orange (apricot), from top to bottom.
flag.symbolism: Officially, red stands for the Armenian Highland and the struggle for survival, blue for the peaceful sky, and orange for the creativity and hard work of the people.

hook: Armenia is red-blue-orange from top to bottom; remember the bottom stripe as an Armenian apricot, a fruit the country is famous for.
trivia: The same tricolour was used by the First Republic of Armenia from 1918 to 1920 and was readopted in 1990.
Armenia is traditionally regarded as the first country to adopt Christianity as its state religion, in 301 AD.
Mount Ararat, a national symbol that appears on the coat of arms, lies across the border in Turkey.
